test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Disasters expose the most ______ section of society to grave danger.
solution:
The correct answer is "**vulnerable**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vulnerable means a person who is weak and helpless .

 
 
• **Example:** *Elsa was in a **vulnerable** situation when she had choose one friend over the other. *
 
 
 
• The sentence demands a **negative word** and other words have a positive connotation. 
 
• Therefore, vulnerable is the appropriate option. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Equitable** - unbiased.

 
 
• **Example**: *All the children inherited an **equitable** share of their father's property.* 
 
 
 
• **Sustainable** - that can stand for a long period of time.
 
 
• **Example**: *Recycling things is a **sustainable** process.* 
 
 
 
• **Potable** - Drinkable.
 
 
• **Example**: *I hope that this tap water is **potable**. *
